'''Althu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chieftain and a vassal of [[Raklann]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he slew a healer [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Raeda-Ke]], for which a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was placed on his head by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Althu was eventually [[Death/Legends|slain]] by an individual looking to claim the bounty.
